t: 第一家美国商业银行北美银行开业。
te: The first American commercial bank, the Bank of North America, opens.
dz: 第一家美国商业银行北美银行开业。
de: The first American commercial bank, the Bank of North America, opens.

t: 财务总监罗伯特·莫里斯(英语:Robert Morris)向美国国会发表讲话,建议设立国家薄荷…
te: Superintendent of Finance Robert Morris addresses the U.S. Congress to recommend establishment of a national mint and d…
dz: 财务总监罗伯特·莫里斯(英语:Robert Morris)向美国国会发表讲话,建议设立国家薄荷和十进制硬币.
de: Superintendent of Finance Robert Morris addresses the U.S. Congress to recommend establishment of a national mint and decimal coinage.

t: 英国下议院投票反对美国进一步发动战争。
te: The House of Commons of Great Britain votes against further war in America.
dz: 美国独立战争：英国下议院投票反对美国进一步发动战争。
de: American Revolutionary War: The House of Commons of Great Britain votes against further war in America.

t: 在俄亥俄州格纳登胡滕有96名已皈依基督教的美国原住民被宾夕法尼亚州民兵杀害,以报复其他印第安部…
te: Ninety-six Native Americans in Gnadenhutten, Ohio, who had converted to Christianity, are killed by Pennsylvania militi…
dz: 格纳登胡滕大屠杀:在俄亥俄州格纳登胡滕有96名已皈依基督教的美国原住民被宾夕法尼亚州民兵杀害,以报复其他印第安部落发动的突袭.
de: Gnadenhutten massacre: Ninety-six Native Americans in Gnadenhutten, Ohio, who had converted to Christianity, are killed by Pennsylvania militiamen in retaliation for raids carried out by other Indian tribes.

t: 第二罗金厄姆内阁在英国就职并开始谈判以结束美国独立战争。
te: The Second Rockingham ministry assumes office in Great Britain and begins negotiations to end the American War of Indep…
dz: 第二罗金厄姆内阁在英国就职并开始谈判以结束美国独立战争。
de: The Second Rockingham ministry assumes office in Great Britain and begins negotiations to end the American War of Independence.

t: 暹罗（现代泰国）佛陀 Yodfa Chulaloke（拉玛一世）建立却克里王朝。
te: King Buddha Yodfa Chulaloke (Rama I) of Siam (modern day Thailand) establishes the Chakri dynasty.
dz: 暹罗（现代泰国）佛陀 Yodfa Chulaloke（拉玛一世）建立却克里王朝。
de: King Buddha Yodfa Chulaloke (Rama I) of Siam (modern day Thailand) establishes the Chakri dynasty.

t: 乔治·罗德尼上将率领的皇家海军舰队在加勒比海多米尼克附近的圣特斯战役中击败了格拉斯伯爵率领的法…
te: A Royal Navy fleet led by Admiral George Rodney defeats a French fleet led by the Comte de Grasse at the Battle of the …
dz: 美国革命：乔治·罗德尼上将率领的皇家海军舰队在加勒比海多米尼克附近的圣特斯战役中击败了格拉斯伯爵率领的法国舰队。
de: American Revolution: A Royal Navy fleet led by Admiral George Rodney defeats a French fleet led by the Comte de Grasse at the Battle of the Saintes off Dominica in the Caribbean Sea.

t: 约翰·亚当斯确保荷兰承认美国为独立政府。他在海牙购买的房子成为第一座美国大使馆。
te: John Adams secures Dutch recognition of the United States as an independent government. The house which he had purchase…
dz: 约翰·亚当斯确保荷兰承认美国为独立政府。他在海牙购买的房子成为第一座美国大使馆。
de: John Adams secures Dutch recognition of the United States as an independent government. The house which he had purchased in The Hague becomes the first American embassy.

t: 拉达那哥欣市，现在在国际上被称为曼谷，由佛陀 Yodfa Chulaloke 国王在湄南河东岸…
te: The city of Rattanakosin, now known internationally as Bangkok, is founded on the eastern bank of the Chao Phraya River…
dz: 拉达那哥欣市，现在在国际上被称为曼谷，由佛陀 Yodfa Chulaloke 国王在湄南河东岸建立。
de: The city of Rattanakosin, now known internationally as Bangkok, is founded on the eastern bank of the Chao Phraya River by King Buddha Yodfa Chulaloke.

t: 大行宫是暹罗国王在曼谷的皇家官邸,由国王活佛约德法·楚拉洛克指挥而开工建设.
te: Construction begins on the Grand Palace, the royal residence of the King of Siam in Bangkok, at the command of King Bud…
dz: 大行宫是暹罗国王在曼谷的皇家官邸,由国王活佛约德法·楚拉洛克指挥而开工建设.
de: Construction begins on the Grand Palace, the royal residence of the King of Siam in Bangkok, at the command of King Buddha Yodfa Chulaloke.

t: 暹罗国王活佛约德法·楚拉洛克(英语:Rama I) (现代泰国)被加冕.
te: King Buddha Yodfa Chulaloke (Rama I) of Siam (modern day Thailand) is crowned.
dz: 暹罗国王活佛约德法·楚拉洛克(英语:Rama I) (现代泰国)被加冕.
de: King Buddha Yodfa Chulaloke (Rama I) of Siam (modern day Thailand) is crowned.

t: 美国国会通过"美国大印".
te: The U.S. Congress adopts the Great Seal of the United States.
dz: 美国国会通过"美国大印".
de: The U.S. Congress adopts the Great Seal of the United States.

t: 美国私家侦探袭击了英国新斯科舍州吕南堡的定居点.
te: American privateers attack the British settlement of Lunenburg, Nova Scotia.
dz: 对吕南堡的突击:美国私家侦探袭击了英国新斯科舍州吕南堡的定居点.
de: Raid on Lunenburg: American privateers attack the British settlement of Lunenburg, Nova Scotia.

t: 乔治·华盛顿下令创建军事功绩徽章以表彰在战斗中受伤的士兵。后来它被重新命名为更具诗意的紫心勋章。
te: George Washington orders the creation of the Badge of Military Merit to honor soldiers wounded in battle. It is later r…
dz: 乔治·华盛顿下令创建军事功绩徽章以表彰在战斗中受伤的士兵。后来它被重新命名为更具诗意的紫心勋章。
de: George Washington orders the creation of the Badge of Military Merit to honor soldiers wounded in battle. It is later renamed to the more poetic Purple Heart.

t: 布鲁利克斯战役：战争的最后一次重大交战，距离英国指挥官查尔斯·康沃利斯在约克镇之围后投降近十个…
te: Battle of Blue Licks: The last major engagement of the war, almost ten months after the surrender of the British comman…
dz: 美国独立战争：布鲁利克斯战役：战争的最后一次重大交战，距离英国指挥官查尔斯·康沃利斯在约克镇之围后投降近十个月。
de: American Revolutionary War: Battle of Blue Licks: The last major engagement of the war, almost ten months after the surrender of the British commander Charles Cornwallis following the Siege of Yorktown.

t: 爱德华·德斯帕德(Edward Despard)手下的英国部队从西班牙人手中完成了对蚊子海岸上…
te: British forces under Edward Despard complete the reconquest of the Black River settlements on the Mosquito Coast from t…
dz: 爱德华·德斯帕德(Edward Despard)手下的英国部队从西班牙人手中完成了对蚊子海岸上黑河定居点的重新收复.
de: British forces under Edward Despard complete the reconquest of the Black River settlements on the Mosquito Coast from the Spanish.

t: 法西联军在直布罗陀大围攻期间发动不成功的“大进攻”。
te: Franco-Spanish troops launch the unsuccessful "grand assault" during the Great Siege of Gibraltar.
dz: 美国独立战争：法西联军在直布罗陀大围攻期间发动不成功的“大进攻”。
de: American Revolutionary War: Franco-Spanish troops launch the unsuccessful "grand assault" during the Great Siege of Gibraltar.

t: 乔治·华盛顿将军在纽约维普朗克角检阅罗尚博将军领导下的法国军队。
te: Review of the French troops under General Rochambeau by General George Washington at Verplanck's Point, New York.
dz: 美国独立战争：乔治·华盛顿将军在纽约维普朗克角检阅罗尚博将军领导下的法国军队。
de: American Revolutionary War: Review of the French troops under General Rochambeau by General George Washington at Verplanck's Point, New York.

t: 巴黎条约：在巴黎，美国和英国代表签署了初步和平条款（后来正式成为 1783 年巴黎条约）。
te: Treaty of Paris: In Paris, representatives from the United States and Great Britain sign preliminary peace articles (la…
dz: 美国独立战争：巴黎条约：在巴黎，美国和英国代表签署了初步和平条款（后来正式成为 1783 年巴黎条约）。
de: American Revolutionary War: Treaty of Paris: In Paris, representatives from the United States and Great Britain sign preliminary peace articles (later formalized as the 1783 Treaty of Paris).

t: 蒙哥菲尔兄弟在法国首次试飞无人热气球；它漂浮近 2.5 公里（1.6 英里）。
te: The Montgolfier brothers first test fly an unmanned hot air balloon in France; it floats nearly 2.5 km (1.6 mi).
dz: 蒙哥菲尔兄弟在法国首次试飞无人热气球；它漂浮近 2.5 公里（1.6 英里）。
de: The Montgolfier brothers first test fly an unmanned hot air balloon in France; it floats nearly 2.5 km (1.6 mi).

t: 穆哈拉姆起义:哈达和马达·米亚领导了次大陆上针对罗伯特·林德赛和他在西尔赫特·沙希·艾德加的分…
te: Muharram Rebellion: Hada and Mada Miah lead the first anti-British uprising in the subcontinent against Robert Lindsay …
dz: 英属东印度公司:穆哈拉姆起义:哈达和马达·米亚领导了次大陆上针对罗伯特·林德赛和他在西尔赫特·沙希·艾德加的分遣队的第一次反英起义.
de: British East India Company: Muharram Rebellion: Hada and Mada Miah lead the first anti-British uprising in the subcontinent against Robert Lindsay and his contingents in Sylhet Shahi Eidgah.
